name: Keep an Eye on the Sky

podcast.body: In 2013, this box set by the cult-favorite Power Pop band Big Star was awarded a Grammy for Best Liner Notes. The notes, written by American rock-a-billy singer Robert Gordon, provided extensive insight into 52 previously unreleased tracks from the band's first three albums of the early and mid-1970s. "Big Star, the cult favorite Power Pop Act for the 1970s, was given a best liner notes Grammy for a box set called Keep an Eye on the Sky."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
